players.product: H3C AI computing servers (UniPoD S80000 supernodes) and data center switches, incl. 51.2T CPO silicon-photonics switches

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report: revenue RMB 63,515,824,069.48, up 33.93%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,166,947,642.39 (+108.18%), excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,873,566,302.98 (+67.59%); gross margin 13.41% (down 1.83 points). ICT infrastructure and services revenue RMB 50,927,318,228.77 (+41.30%, 80.18% of revenue, gross margin 15.28%); IT product distribution and supply-chain services RMB 14,600,263,817.03 (+4.17%). Subsidiary New H3C's revenue was RMB 499.75 hundred million (+37.28%) and net profit RMB 23.88 hundred million (+29.03%); its domestic government and enterprise revenue RMB 438.67 hundred million (+41.35%). In June 2026 the company completed buying a further 6.98% of New H3C, raising its holding from 81% to 87.98%, which it says adds to attributable profit. Operating cash flow was RMB -4,208,607,982.16 as purchase payments rose with business scale.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 63,515,824,069.48 (+33.93%); ICT infrastructure RMB 50,927,318,228.77 (+41.30%); H3C revenue RMB 499.75 hundred million (+37.28%)

quarterly_data.signal: New products (H1 2026 report): the new UniServer S90000 high-density fully liquid-cooled whole rack, a general high-performance compute platform, raises compute density 3 times over traditional designs; its full series of single-chip 102.4T intelligent-computing switches adds CPO (co-packaged optics), NPO (near-packaged optics) and CPC (co-packaged copper) for higher-density, higher-throughput scale-up and scale-out; it also launched a new AI firewall with 16T throughput for AI compute clusters, a pumped two-phase cold-plate liquid-cooling system for high-density data centers and the X20000 AI-native storage series. R&D investment in H1 2026 was RMB 2,469,087,447.42 (+0.88%).
quarterly_data.figure: S90000 liquid-cooled rack: 3 times compute density; 102.4T switches with CPO / NPO / CPC; 16T AI firewall

quarterly_data.signal: Wins (H1 2026 report): it won China Telecom's 2026-2027 high-performance server procurement, China Telecom Cloud's 2026 400G box switch procurement, China Telecom's 2026 firewall procurement, China Mobile's 2026-2027 RoCE switch and hardware firewall procurements and a China Tower micro-module project, supporting domestic-technology intelligent computing centers at several provincial operator units. It takes part in internet customers' AI computing cluster builds, supporting stable deployment of ten-thousand-card-class AI clusters with scale-up, scale-out and scale-across interconnect and 800G networking, and says its AI compute hardware and data center network products rank among the top in that market. Its AI servers and intelligent-computing network products were deployed at scale at joint-stock banks, leading insurers and brokers, and its high-compute liquid-cooling solution was deployed at scale at leading high-end precision-manufacturing customers.
quarterly_data.figure: China Telecom 2026-2027 server and China Mobile 2026-2027 RoCE switch procurement wins; ten-thousand-card-class AI clusters

quarterly_data.signal: Market positions (H1 2026 report, citing IDC data for Q1 2026): China Ethernet switch share 36.6%, data center switch 35.8%, campus switch 38.2% and enterprise-network switch 38.1%, all first; enterprise router 30.8% (second); enterprise WLAN 32.6% (first); x86 server 14.9% (second); blade server 37.3% (first); storage 12.0% (second).
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 China data center switch 35.8% (first); x86 server 14.9% (second); storage 12.0% (second)

quarterly_data.signal: Supply and capacity (H1 2026 report): the company says it applied a diversified-supplier policy and deeper strategic coordination with core suppliers to keep supply stable, and is building a global logistics center and local warehousing against supply-chain volatility. Inventory rose to RMB 51,055,703,040.95 (46.79% of total assets) and accounts payable to RMB 26,142,542,753.46 on higher purchases; asset impairment losses rose 161.66% to RMB 675,539,912.16, mainly larger inventory write-downs at New H3C; the largest prepayee held 22.68% of prepayments. Construction in progress was RMB 782,214,378.97, mainly a subsidiary's new-generation ICT product smart-factory project (budget RMB 999,384,774.44, 66.35% complete) and the Digital Economy Science Park phase 1 smart factory (72.16%) and headquarters base (36.58%).
quarterly_data.figure: inventory RMB 51,055,703,040.95; construction in progress RMB 782,214,378.97; ICT smart factory 66.35% complete

quarterly_data.signal: Company plan for H2 2026 (half-year report): it will keep improving AI-infrastructure system coordination and integrated delivery, strengthen the core competitiveness of its products and solutions, optimise its business layout and build a diversified, independent and resilient supply system; overseas, it says that with its own channel network now at scale it will invest more resources to raise revenue scale and profitability.
